# DPI, the sensor byte (packet byte 8), the y byte (byte 16) and whether the stage is doubled (bit 0 of byte 6),
# as the vendor's own software wrote them for stage 1. Read out of 320 packets published by
# HarukaYamamoto0/attack-shark-x11-driver (docs/samples/dpi.json, MIT; their file says "paste", it doesn't say
# who captured them). Dorsal sends 310 of them. The other 10 are 20100, which the vendor's Windows software writes
# as an odd code of its own, and the nine odd hundreds above it, which it snaps down (its web hub snaps them up),
# so they're listed here as what the vendor's software did, not as values Dorsal sends.
# (The whole packets are in x11_captured_packets.txt.)
